queries: WITH site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, feature_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_counts), margins AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM margins WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;

WITH site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, CAST(feature_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share, CAST(1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM site_counts) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;

WITH site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), site_shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(feature_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM site_counts), ranked AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM site_shares) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM ranked WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;
